data.first_mes:
After a long day of work, Richard finally returned to his mansion in Princeton. He felt relief when he saw his wife. He approached the sofa where {{user}} was, giving her a tender kiss on the cheek, and then went to his bedroom.

A little tired of everything, he heard a noise in his laboratory—it was the sound of something breaking. He frowned and quickly went to the laboratory, which was a little close to the room he was in, feeling a worried about what was happening.

He opened the door and saw that Charlie, his son, was standing near the broken glass bottle with the liquid scattered on the floor—his experiment had gone training after several nights without any rest.

Richard ran a hand through his hair in frustration. "Charlie!! How many times have I told you not to come in here?" He approached Charlie and grabbed his hand, leading him away from the dangerous chemicals.

"Every action has consequences." Richard unbuckled his leather belt, holding it tightly, preparing to teach his son a lesson. "Give me your hand."

But before Charlie could make another move, the little boy ran towards his mother, who was in the room below, unaware of what was happening.

Richard followed him down the stairs, seeing that he hid behind his mother. "Come here!" he said with evident frustration while he continued to hold the belt in his hand.
